text: Attach scorers to tasks: code checks verify concrete outputs or recorded changes, and an LLM judge assesses qualities like clarity or completeness
quote: Write a task and attach scorers that check its requirements. Code checks concrete outputs or recorded changes; an LLM judge assesses qualities such as clarity or completeness.

text: Scorers return a value from 0 to 1, with configurable pass thresholds that decide whether each required check passed
quote: Scorers return a value from 0 to 1; set pass thresholds to determine whether each required check passed.

text: Compare agent versions on the same tasks and starting state, and inspect the recorded actions behind each score
quote: Compare agent versions on the same tasks and starting state, then inspect the recorded actions behind each score to understand failures.

text: Register an agent to record its instructions, model, and tools so changes can be tracked between versions
quote: register your agent. This records its instructions, model, and tools so you can track changes between versions.

text: Task suites group tasks so the same tests can be run against every agent version
quote: A task suite groups tasks so you can run the same tests against every agent version.

text: Freezes a suite's current tasks and scorers into a version pinned to each run, so later edits don't change past results
quote: Chronicle freezes the suite's current tasks and scorers into a version and pins it to the run, so later edits don't change this result.

text: Worldsmith builds a simulated world from a written description, from a single service up to a workflow across connected tools
quote: Worldsmith builds that world from your description, from a single service to a workflow across connected tools.

text: Simulated service twins that an agent can read from and write to through the real vendor's API
quote: Simulated services that your agent can read and write through the vendor's API.

text: The agent talks to twins exactly as it would to the real service; writes persist, and every request and changed record is recorded
quote: Your agent talks to it exactly as it would talk to the real service. Writes stick, and Chronicle records every request and every changed record.

text: Loads connected Slack, Linear, Salesforce, and SAP sample records plus ready-made tasks
quote: Chronicle loads connected Slack, Linear, Salesforce, and SAP records, plus two ready-made tasks.

text: Bring an existing agent and test how it performs in a simulated world
quote: Bring your existing agent to Chronicle to test how it performs in a simulated world.

text: Published environment versions are frozen, so every trial starts from the same state
quote: A published version of an environment is frozen, so every trial, today or next month, starts from the same state.

text: Custom environment versions can use recorded HTTP replays, seeded datastores, MCP servers, or standalone twins
quote: A custom version can describe recorded HTTP replays, seeded datastores, MCP servers, or standalone twins.

text: Reset discards runtime changes and restores the original seed data
quote: Reset throws away runtime changes and restores the original seed.

text: Each trial gets its own fresh twins built from the saved world, so trials are isolated from each other
quote: every trial gets its own fresh twins built from the saved world... nothing one trial does affects the next.

text: Build worlds, write tasks, and run evaluations in the browser
quote: Build worlds, write tasks, and run evaluations in the browser.

text: Official SDKs for Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, and Rust
quote: Automate workflows with Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, or Rust.

text: All SDKs expose the same resources with the same method names, adapted to each language's conventions
quote: Every SDK exposes the same resources with the same method names, adjusted to the language's conventions.

text: API keys carry scopes, such as platform for CI keys and agents:write and traces:write for agent processes
quote: A CI key typically has platform. A key supplied to your agent process typically has agents:write and traces:write.

text: Idempotent world and run creation: the same key and inputs return the original object, so retries after a timeout or crash are safe
quote: Same key, same inputs: you get the original world or run back. Safe to retry after a timeout or crash.

text: Ingest traces via the SDK or an OpenTelemetry exporter pointed at Chronicle
quote: Use SDK trace ingestion or an OpenTelemetry exporter pointed at Chronicle.

text: Send events from your code or your agent's tool calls, then query them in Timeline or through the SDK
quote: Send them from your own code, from your agent's tool calls, or from an OpenTelemetry exporter, then query them in Timeline or through the SDK.

text: Semantic search over event content through the SDK or the POST /v1/search API endpoint
quote: events.search(query) | POST /v1/search | Semantic search over event content.

text: Timeline shows everything one agent did during one trial, along with its scoring
quote: Backtests → a trial → Timeline | Everything one agent did during one trial, plus scoring.

text: Turn a useful trace into a new task with Add trace
quote: Found a useful case? Choose Add trace to turn it into a task.

text: Turn production data into staging environments for testing and validating AI agents
quote: Turn your production data into staging environments for AI agent testing and validation.

text: Turns production patterns into tests and replays them to judge whether agents are ready for launch
quote: It then turns those patterns into tests and replays them to determine whether your AI agents are ready for launch.

text: Connect tools, capture real conversations, and replay events for training and evaluation from the dashboard
quote: Connect your tools, capture real conversations, and start replaying events for training and evaluation - all from your dashboard.

text: Workflow Discovery reconstructs end-to-end workflows from production data streams
quote: Workflow Discovery: Reconstructs end-to-end workflows from production data streams.

text: Real-time monitoring of production agents with autonomous fix and rollback
quote: Real-time monitoring of production agents with autonomous fix and rollback.

text: Initial assessment that reviews an existing agent deployment and surfaces its failure modes
quote: Initial assessment that reviews an existing agent deployment and surfaces failure modes.
